title: GPU OOM auto-fallback and kernel hard-fail handling
description:
## Goal

GPU stages **signal** OOM and kernel/driver errors via the typed
`StageError` enum and declare a compile-bound
`Stage::CpuFallback` associated type per Phase 0 §1 and §8. They
do NOT implement the CPU-fallback dispatch — that's the
executor's job (`42eac5cc`).

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages) within epic `gf2-sim`
(`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §1 (associated-type
fallback shape, user-approved Q6 2026-06-07), §8 (failure-mode
policy + explicit seam decision). Wave B.3: depends on
`f6004add`, `a930be7f`, `d3f1616a` (the GPU stages whose error
paths this task wires).

This task is the "GPU error-signalling discipline" task. It does
NOT contain the CPU fallback dispatch logic — that's in
`42eac5cc`. It DOES contain:
- Audit of every `hip*` call site in Phase B kernels for proper
  `RecoverableError::OutOfMemory` vs `FatalError::KernelLaunch`
  classification.
- Per-stage `Stage::CpuFallback` associated type declarations
  (verifies every Phase B GPU stage names a real CPU equivalent).
- Fault-injection test infrastructure that simulates OOM and
  kernel errors.

## Deliverables

1. Audit + corrections across `gf2-kernels-hip/src/host/alloc.rs`,
   `host/launch.rs`, and every Phase B kernel wrapper:
   - Every `hipMalloc` failure path returns
     `RecoverableError::OutOfMemory{ device_id, bytes_requested }`.
   - Every `hipGetLastError` non-zero return after a kernel launch
     returns `FatalError::KernelLaunch{ hip_code, kernel, args }`.
   - No `unwrap()` / `panic!` on HIP error paths.
2. Verify every Phase B GPU stage declares a `Stage::CpuFallback`
   associated type and returns `Some(&self.fallback)` from the
   `cpu_fallback()` method (per `ec530af9` §1):
   - `impl Stage<SymbolBatch, SymbolBatch> for GpuAwgn {
        type CpuFallback = channels::Awgn;
        fn cpu_fallback(&self) -> Option<&Self::CpuFallback> { Some(&self.fallback) }
        ...
      }`
   - `impl Stage<LlrBatch, HardDecisionBatch> for GpuLdpcBp {
        type CpuFallback = LdpcDecoder; ...
      }`
   - `impl Stage<SymbolBatch, LlrBatch> for GpuGrayQamDemapper {
        type CpuFallback = FastGrayQamDemapper; ...
      }`
3. Fault-injection test infrastructure in
   `crates/gf2-sim/tests/gpu_fault_injection.rs`:
   - `OomInjector` wraps a stage and forces
     `RecoverableError::OutOfMemory` on the Nth invocation.
   - `KernelErrorInjector` similarly forces
     `FatalError::KernelLaunch`.
   - These are test-only utilities; production stages do not use
     them.
4. CLI flag `--strict-gpu` plumbed through `PipelineConfig` so the
   campaign binary can opt into "no fallback" semantics. When set,
   the executor (Phase C `42eac5cc`) promotes OOM to
   `FatalError::OutOfMemory` per the new enum variant added to
   `ec530af9` §1 (user-approved Q7 2026-06-07).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Code audit: zero `unwrap()` / `panic!` on HIP error paths
  in `gf2-kernels-hip/src/host/` or `gf2-sim/src/gpu/`.
- [hard] Every Phase B GPU stage's `Stage::CpuFallback` associated
  type is declared and `cpu_fallback()` returns `Some(&self.fallback)`;
  verified by a unit test in `tests/gpu_cpu_fallback_present.rs`.
- [hard] Fault-injection infrastructure compiles and is used by
  `42eac5cc` (Phase C) to drive the executor's substitution test;
  this task's own tests verify the injectors produce the expected
  error types.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- This task does NOT implement the CPU-fallback dispatch — that
  lives in `42eac5cc`. Phase 0 design doc §8 owns the seam decision.
- No diagnostic-dump format (also `42eac5cc`).
- No new GPU stages (`f6004add`, `a930be7f`, `d3f1616a` already
  cover Phase B).
